item.title: Defect-driven subsurface phase transformation kinetically enables extended solid-solution pathway in high-voltage spinel cathodes
item.description:
تبدیل فاز زیرسطحی ناشی از نقص، مسیر محلول جامد را در کاتد اسپینلی ولتاژ بالا LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4 گسترش می‌دهد.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Defect-driven subsurface phase transformation enables a kinetically stabilized extended solid-solution pathway in high-voltage LNMO spinel cathodes, resolving the ordering-versus-kinetics trade-off. This defect-engineering strategy suppresses phase transitions, improves rate capability and cycling stability, and offers a design principle for cobalt-free high-voltage cathodes.
🏷 LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4 · spinel cathode · subsurface phase transformation · solid-solution pathway · defect engineering

item.title: Influence of Organic Carbon Source on Precursor Chemistry, Crystallization Behavior, and Electrochemical Phase-Transformation Kinetics of Spray-Dried Na3V2(PO4)3
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This study reveals how different organic carbon sources govern precursor chemistry, crystallization, and electrochemical phase-transformation kinetics in spray-dried Na3V2(PO4)3. By linking carbon source choice to sodium-ion battery performance, it provides mechanistic insight beyond empirical carbon coating, enabling rational design of high-rate cathode materials.
